app.name: Assay
app.error: Assay cannot load this page. Try again.
app.notFoundBody: This page does not exist, or you cannot see it.

palette.title: Search and go
palette.placeholder: Type a page or a setting

auth.signInBody: Use the email and password from your invite.
auth.badCredentials: The email or the password is not correct.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
auth.noAccount: No account? Ask an admin for an invite link.

setup.title: Set up Assay
setup.body: Create the first admin account. The install script printed the setup token.
setup.tokenHint: ASSAY_SETUP_TOKEN in the .env file of the install.
setup.name: Your name
setup.badToken: The setup token is not correct.
setup.disabled: Setup is off. Set ASSAY_SETUP_TOKEN, or run assay admin create.

invite.title: Join Assay
invite.body: You have an invite as {role} for {email}. Set your name and password.
invite.name: Your name
invite.invalidTitle: This invite link does not work
invite.invalidBody: The link is used, revoked or expired. Ask an admin for a new link.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.body: The link works once. All your sessions end after the change.
reset.done: Your password changed. Sign in with the new password.
reset.invalidTitle: This reset link does not work
reset.invalidBody: The link is used or expired. Ask an admin for a new link.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.changed: Your password changed. Other sessions ended.
profile.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.
profile.sessionsBody: These browsers are signed in to your account.

users.title: Users
users.body: Invite people, change roles and deactivate accounts.
users.inviteBody: Assay makes a link that works once for 7 days. Copy it and send it to the person.
users.linkBody: Copy this link now. It shows only once.
users.emailed: Assay also sent the link by email.
users.resetBody: Copy this link and send it to the person. It works once for 24 hours.
users.lastAdmin: This is the last active admin. Make another admin first.
users.userExists: A user with this email exists.
users.roleHelp: Members ask and explore. Reviewers also decide review cards. Admins also manage settings.
users.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {email}? Their sessions and access tokens stop at once.

groups.title: Groups
groups.body: Groups decide who can read the content of a connection.
groups.name: Name
groups.everyoneHelp: Everyone holds all active users. It cannot change.
groups.confirmDelete: Delete the group {name}? Connections shared with it stop being visible to its members.
groups.empty: No groups other than Everyone. Create a group to share a connection with some people.
groups.nameTaken: A group with this name exists.

general.title: General
general.retentionBody: A daily job deletes records that are older than these limits.
general.stale: Another admin changed this setting. Reload the page and try again.

smtp.title: Email
smtp.body: Set an SMTP server to send invite links by email. Without it, copy invite links by hand.
smtp.hostHint: Leave empty to turn email off.
smtp.passwordHint: Write-only. Leave empty to keep the current password.
smtp.securityNone: None, for a local relay only

audit.title: Audit log
audit.body: Every change to users, settings, connections and reviews. Entries cannot change.
audit.filterHint: An action, such as user.role, or a prefix, such as user.

errors.forbidden: Your role does not permit this action.
errors.network: Assay cannot reach the server. Check the connection.

models.title: Models
models.body: Assay calls models through endpoints. Each function has its own model, prices and monthly budget.
models.endpointsBody: An endpoint is an OpenAI-compatible API or the OpenRouter Decisions API.
models.noEndpoints: No endpoints. Add an endpoint to turn on the model functions.
models.name: Name
models.baseUrlHintOpenai: The URL before /chat/completions, such as https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.
models.baseUrlHintDecisions: The URL before /alpha/decisions, such as https://openrouter.ai/api.
models.apiKeyHint: Write-only. Leave empty to keep the current key.
models.headersHint: One header per line, as Name: value.
models.bodyDefaultsHint: A JSON object. Assay adds these fields to each request.
models.invalidJson: The extra body fields must be a JSON object.
models.confirmDelete: Delete the endpoint {name}? Functions that use it turn off.
models.testModelHint: Leave empty to use the first listed model.
models.testOk: The test passed with {model}. The endpoint lists {count} models.
models.functionsBody: Spend counts the current month. A function that is off uses its degraded mode.
models.priceIn: Input price, USD per million tokens
models.priceOut: Output price, USD per million tokens
models.invalidParams: The parameters must be a JSON object.
models.incomplete: Set an endpoint and a model before you turn the function on.
models.fnExtract: Claims and term drafts from passages.
models.banner: The monthly budget of {functions} is used up. Assay refuses these calls until an admin raises the budget.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.body: Checks of the database, the secret key, the proxy, the CA certificates and each endpoint.
diagnostics.someFail: Some checks fail. Each failed check names its cause.
diagnostics.notRun: Run the checks to see the state of this install.
